title: Analysis tool states and definitive coverage per tool and block
population: GENERATED (state shares; diagnostic only; never mixed with FINAL or STEP rates); BASE and GENERATED (coverage)
notes: State shares over all GENERATED artifacts (diagnostic population); NOT_APPLICABLE and ABSENT_INAPPLICABLE are shown separately and never counted as analysis gaps; coverage = COMPLETED among artifacts to which the tool applies.

EFFECTIVE_STATES: Tool states are the effective states (framework.effective_tool_state): a front-end TOOL_ERROR or PARTIAL entry of an artifact whose build failed counts as NOT_ANALYZED (dataset_disclosures.effective_state_overrides); the closure register reports the raw states.

definitions.text: GENERATED: all 5,460 artifacts (1,980 base + 3,480 repair candidates) (use: diagnostic only; never mixed with FINAL or STEP rates)
BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)
S01 static_tool_state_distribution: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact x static tool.
S02 static_definitive_coverage: numerator = COMPLETED; denominator = artifacts to which the tool applies; unit = artifact x static tool.
D01 dynamic_tool_state_distribution: numerator = artifacts per state; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact x dynamic tool.
D02 dynamic_definitive_coverage: numerator = COMPLETED; denominator = applicable artifacts; unit = artifact x dynamic tool.
